evidence: Handheld unit displays an offset boxy dust container, ribbed cylindrical chamber, and closed loop handle characteristic of a Shark cordless vacuum rather than Dyson cyclone architecture.
contradictions: The body architecture lacks Dyson's in-line cylindrical canister, radial cyclones, and rear circular filter housing.

candidate_checks.evidence: Lacks the in-line cylindrical transparent bin, radial cyclone assembly, and pistol-grip trigger handle of the V15.
Lacks the slim in-line cyclone body, circular rear filter, and top red push-button control of the V12.
Machine is a dry cordless handheld unit rather than an upright wet floor cleaner with dual tanks.
